name: Simple Template: Cold Iron Elemental (CR +0)[3pp]
body:
Cold-iron elemental is a simple template that can be applied only to earth elementals. It indicates a creature from the plane of earth that is made entirely of cold iron.

Quick Rules: remove earth glide and earth mastery special abilities; natural attacks count as cold iron; gains SR equal to 5 + HD.

Monsters that have been created using this template:

Cold Iron Elemental, Small
Cold Iron Elemental, Medium
Cold Iron Elemental, Large
Cold Iron Elemental, Huge
Cold Iron Elemental, Greater
Cold Iron Elemental, Elder
